name: Inside the Box
source:
You have entered the Neverplace. You are lost to the world that you once knew. Answer all questions but ask none.  [s](No, you do not have to do this. You can escape).[/s]

You play as the Crooked Man's apprentice, waking in a dark realm you don’t recognise. You meet a mysterious creature that sits waiting patiently for you to open a box. What is inside it is a mystery, it could be a precious commodity…or it could be a trap. It doesn’t know, and neither do you…

[From [url=https://seraten04.itch.io/inside-the-box]itch.io[/url]]
